reviews.t: Very Well Made But Not Serving The Intended Purpose
reviews.x: This wooden Pocket Beard Comb is very fine in all regards -- well made, strong, durable. Comes with a nice case for carrying in your pocket. My only issue with it is that I ordered this as a choice between a moustache comb or wooden comb, and thought this would be more durable, which it clearly is. But this wooden comb is so thick and the smaller side teeth so fine that I cannot tell whether it is really combing anything or just rubbing along a solid edge. The heavy ends make it impossible to re

reviews.t: Best 5$ a guy with a beard can spend
reviews.x: Great inexpensive way to see if a sandlewood comb is for you. This comb is well made with very even and smooth teeth that does not pull hair and seems to straighten my wild wirey beard. I like to zone off watching tv and comb my beard and it sooths my skin without scraping or tearing out hair like a plastic comb or your fingernails.  I have since got a folding comb that is a little sturdier in the pocket but I still like the fine teeth on this one slightly better and the fact that it is two side

reviews.t: You Got to Have One - Trust Me
reviews.x: I really like this comb. It really fits your hand and its totally different than a conventional comb. The feel of the wood is soothing (I know it sounds crazy). The leather case gives it a special touch.

reviews.t: Awesome product and most important, will not pull your hair out.
reviews.x: Over the past few months, my beard has grown out of control and the plastic comb I was previously using wasn't helping manage my beard at all.  I read some of the reviews and wondered if this wood comb is legit. Well it is! I was really excited to try it out. Unlike my other comb, this does not pull my hair. It glides through with ease. I would recommend this to anyone with any type of beard.  I would say between this and beard oil, you are set!

Nicely made comb: nice shape and bevel. My husband has been absentmindedly combing his beard while watching tv since it arrived. I assume it feels good. One star off because that case is not leather as described, it’s faux.

A very well made and attractive sandlewood beard grooming comb.  The included carrying sleeve is an appreciated bonus.  The excellent price point places this comb in a really "good buy" catagory.  I am pleased with this purchase and  intend to buy more to give as gifts to all my bearded friends.  I purchased this product at retail from Amazon and this review reflects my honest and unbiased opinion.
my husband loves this comb! it fits perfectly in his pocket and now he's actually taking care of his facial hair and hair because of this. Its a pretty and sturdy comb so far.

Excellent comb! Well made. Reasonably priced for the quality. I will buy several more for bearded friends and gifts. I also know several with "comb-overs" who would benefit from this comb (and some white glue.)

reviews.t: Nice wooden comb that both feels and smells great
reviews.x: This comb is perfect! It is just asymmetric enough to not feel "mass manufactured." (I'm sure it must be, the kerfs between the teeth are very precise, but, still, it has character probably due to some small, normal warping of the wood.) Sandalwood has natural oils which not only smell great, but (maybe it's my imagination?) even feel great against my face and scalp. It comes with a nice leather pouch (not fancy, but with a logo impressed (without any dye) into the leather). This is nece

It appeared quite sturdy and I was very pleased with my purchase, until the comb broke into two pieces! I guess I'm going to try and see if I can get a replacement from the seller! Until then, I am not pleased!

reviews.t: Works as it should. Great quality, no smell,  perfect 4 pocket or travel.
reviews.x: What an awesome beard comb, seriously my husband has this in his pocket all the time now & he was never that type. Nice leather (like?) pouch for the thick solid wood comb. It's thicker in the middle which gives a gd grip & works great. For the price I was expecting thinner & cheaper quality. This comb did not come w any bad smells like another reviewer mentioned. Hopefully that was just a lemon out of the batch & he got a replacement. My husband says it feels good to run either side of the comb

I don't leave many negative reviews, but this comb was a non-starter for me. I took it out of the little plastic bag it comes in and noticed the paint smell immediately. The carry sleeve the comb comes with is sort of a synthetic material that is dyed or painted to look like leather. It smelled like the dye hadn't been allowed to fully dry before the comb was packaged up. The smell was on the comb also so I didn't want to go putting it near my face. Tossed it out.

reviews.t: Great comb, not so great case.
reviews.x: It's a great comb, I love the look, the smell of the sandalwood and the feel of it while using. It would have been a solid 5 star rating except I specifying searched for combs with a leather case. The faux leather case that came with it was a big disappointment. I would have gladly paid a few bucks more for a bomb that came with a real leather case.

You'll regularly see other brands selling this same things for about 4x what this cost. They are no nicer. Good construction, no static, lays the whiskers down nicely. Oh, and it smells good. Don't pay more, this is all you want.

reviews.t: Works so much better than I had hoped or thought possible.
reviews.x: Bought this on a whim after seeing it. Truly didn’t think there would be any difference between a regular plastic comb and this comb.... I was wrong, very wrong. This comb works so much better and for the life of me I can’t explain it. Maybe it’s the lack of static from the wood or the natural oils in the sandalwood... I really am at a loss to explain it. My beard has never been so easy to to comb through or easy to tame. And the mustache side works great with my mustache wax. The wood smells gr

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: This was a gift, and the person that received it says "it works". That's all. When I received it the plastic bag that it came in was glued to the comb, so I had to spend half an hour separating and getting the glue off the comb. In regards to the leather case, nobody that has felt it believes its anything other than plastic. Something you'd see in a children's toy box. Its very cheap feeling and the comb barely fits in it, and is a struggle to get it out. The person I gifted this to thro

reviews.t: Great comb, case is NOT leather
reviews.x: The comb is great. Real simple. It’s quite a bit like a ton of the other combs you can find just like it on amazon or in stores.  The case on the other hand is not leather as advertised so just know that upfront. It has a leather feel but it’s obvious when you inspect it, it’s not leather.  No problems with the product or case, shipped quick and does the job. Just missed a star for the minor misleading.

reviews.t: Well made, bearded boyfriend loves it!
reviews.x: I got this for my boyfriend for Valentine's Day, and he already LOVES it! The sandalwood smells wonderful, and the craftsmanship is phenomenal. The small size teeth are perfect for his mustache and beard, while the larger teeth are great for the hair on his head!
It’s a great beard comb. The leather pocket looks great. There’s just a really funky smell to it. I’m hoping that wears off with use. Has anybody else experienced this? Any fixes?
Waaaay to thick and clunky, plus they advertised a leather carrying case but it was clearly made of vinyl. Avoid this......

reviews.t: Great buy! Was looking for a pocket comb that ...
reviews.x: Great buy!  Was looking for a pocket comb that was not too bulky and wouldn't scratch my phone in the same pocket.
Gave this as a gift to my son.  He absolutely loves it and lets me know often.
Love it, is the second one I purchase. This one is to keep in the car.

I used to use a plastic beard comb and I decided to switch to a wooden one. I am glad I happened to choose this one because it is really perfect for me. I know it seems silly to rave over a beard comb but it is very affordable and very high quality compared to other brands I tried. If you're not used to the smell of sandal wood, it can be a bit funky at first, but it's really grown on me.  I can comb my beard very smoothly and it helps distribute beard oil or beard butter as well.  I like it bet

I do not have a beard, as I am a woman, but I do have blunt-cut bangs with a tendency to get everywhere. This size comb is perfect to leave in a bag all day (about the size of a credit card, in its own little pleather envelope), and the teeth are fine enough to put everything in its place but sturdy enough to handle my thick hair.  If you’re buying this as a gift, it would make a cute and useful stocking stuffer, but the little sleeve it comes in isn’t as nice as the comb itself.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the comb as well made, sturdy, and good quality.
Many say it works better than plastic combs, not pulling hair and managing beards well.
Several reviewers consider it a great value for the price.
Some reviewers were disappointed that the included case is faux/synthetic leather rather than real leather as described.
A few reviewers mention a bad smell, and one reports the comb cracked/broke after 12 days.
